newsitem.title: UK: Energy Group rises, boosted by FT report.
newsitem.headline: Energy Group rises, boosted by FT report.

text.p: Shares in Energy Group rose 11-1/2 pence to 547-1/2, boosted by a background article in the Financial Times which highlighted the synergies from the group's coal and electricity operations, dealers said.

Energy Group was floated in February as it was demerged from conglomerate Hanson Plc. The company's shares fell from a post-float high of 570 pence to 466-1/2 in mid-April, but have started a recovery since then.
The FT report quoted an analyst saying the shares were worth over 560 pence, giving extra impetus to Energy Group, dealers said.
